{{Quote|He was a Patrolian. That's a fish guy.|[[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]]|<ref name="LL">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>}}
'''Patrolians''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] from the world<ref name="LL" /> [[Patrolia/Legends|Patrolia]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|The galaxy]].

==Biology and Description==
Members of the species were distinguished by their pale, pastel-colored scales and long, fin-like limbs. They could resist minor electrocutions. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] was a member of this species,<ref name="IO" /> as was the criminal [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]].<ref name="LL" /> Another [[Unidentified Patrolian (Moshi Bar)/Legends|member]] of the species was seen in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Not_Robonibo.png|thumb|left|140px|Unused Episode I Jedi concept art that later became Patrolian]]
The Patrolian design was based on unused [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Episode I'']] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] concept art by [[Iain McCaig]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}}</ref> which appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>
